stance_rationale: Full-panel alpha gates fail on rank_IC, ICIR, DSR, decile monotonicity, RF-A3, and corrected Newey-West t-stat; the package's Harvey t=44.413 is arithmetically invalid. The available alpha_scores.parquet is a real 252-date time-series panel, but PIT/liquidity and process artifacts are not clean enough for approval.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet has Date x Ticker x score panel with 77,281 rows, 252 monthly sig_dates, no duplicated Date-Ticker keys, variable ticker counts 173-352, and last sig_date <= 2026-05-08.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Signal columns use Z_Score_Aligned via load_month_factors; no NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN found.
factor_ic_monthly.parquet has Usable_Date and connector filters ic_hist[Usable_Date <= sig_date].
run_all.R directly reads .cache/factor_db/factor_db_*.parquet at lines 49-54 to build sig_dates, despite package claiming connector-exclusive factor DB access.
No DD/VT/regime overlay is used for alpha scoring; AX-001 split is diagnostic only.
Selected factors are price-derived VaR and momentum; no financial-statement factor lag is invoked.
Liquidity filter uses Date <= sd in run_all.R, so same-day Close*Vol enters the 20d ADV universe filter.

critical_concerns.description: The package reports Harvey-NW t=44.413, but recomputing from ic_per_date.parquet gives corrected NW t=2.8033 because the code divides the Newey-West variance by n twice. This flips the multi-testing gate from PASS to FAIL.
Full-panel rank_IC=0.0314 < 0.04, ICIR=0.1807 < 0.20, and DSR=0.000 < 0.50; recent-60m strength cannot override the full walk-forward graduation gates.

RF-A3 is live: recent 3Y ICIR is more than 2.5x the full-panel ICIR, and the package converts that instability into a retail-democratization narrative rather than treating it as overfit/regime-dependence risk.
Decile monotonicity is weak at 0.588 and HML Sharpe is only 0.142; this is not enough evidence that a long-only top-20 optimizer can extract the claimed signal.
The liquidity filter uses same-day volume through Date <= sd, which violates the no same-day liquidity rule even if the selected alpha factors themselves are lagged.
C15 is not clean: run_all.R directly reads factor_db_*.parquet for signal-date construction while the package states no direct factor DB parquet access.

No challenge_note.md, factor_engine_proposal.R, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, risk_package.json, or optimization_package.json was found for the specified WT paths, so No Silent Override and 3-source triangulation remain incomplete.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet passes the RF-A7 time-series requirement: 252 monthly sig_dates, 2005-05-31 to 2026-04-30, Date-Ticker-score panel, variable universe, and no future sig_date.
Top-decile liquidity appears adequate in the reported last-date diagnostic, and turnover_annual=3.2224 is below the 600% hard limit.
Sector-neutral retention is not an RF-A4 failure: reported IC retention is 0.617 and ICIR falls from 0.1807 to 0.1417, less than a 50% collapse.
unresolved_disputes: Whether AX-001 v2 defensive classification can be used at all before Risk/Forge verifies crisis_alpha and Core MDD attenuation.
Whether the Korea retail-democratization story is independently measured with PIT retail-flow data rather than fitted after observing post-2020 IC strength.
Whether the hard max_names=20 long-only production form will satisfy any AX-007 exception; the alpha package defers this instead of proving it.
Requested covariance.parquet PSD and condition-number checks could not be performed because no covariance.parquet exists in the specified WT artifact paths.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that a full-panel gate-failing alpha can be conditionally accepted because recent Korea retail participation allegedly activated the Atilgan mechanism.
rebuttal_required: Recompute Harvey/Newey-West t-stat with a correct HAC variance formula and update all graduation claims.
Provide a PIT retail-flow conditioning test showing the post-2020 effect was specified ex ante, not explained after RF-A3 fired.
Fix C10 by lagging liquidity inputs to t-1 and regenerate alpha_scores.parquet.
Remove direct factor_db_*.parquet reads or justify them under C15 with an approved connector method.
Provide challenge_note.md covering RF-A1 through RF-A7 and complete AX-008 triangulation artifacts.
rationalization_red_flags: Acceptable bypass via Harvey-NW t hard-pass + sign consistency + AX-001 v2 strong

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The artifact panel exists and avoids the Iter-4 single-snapshot bug, but the claimed statistical pass relies on a broken HAC t-stat and post-hoc recent-regime rationalization.

alpha_specific_questions: 이 factor가 KR market에서 corrected t_NW > 2.95를 full-panel fund-of-fund 환경에서 유지할 수 있는가?
alpha vector 시계열에 future leakage 없는가? 특히 C10 same-day liquidity와 C15 direct factor_db access를 제거해도 IC가 유지되는가?
AX-007 EXCEPTION을 실제 long-only max20 optimizer 구조에서 충족하는가, 아니면 cross-sectional IC만 있고 portfolio translation은 실패하는가?
